warnings: B1 and B2 are simple boxed cross-sections only (no elevation), top=bottom, uniform stirrup -- highest confidence.

B3/B3A/B3X are drawn as two elevations sharing one rebar pattern each ('B3,B3A' and 'B3,B3X'), with a labelled cut at each end confirming which face carries the extra curtailed Ø12mm bar: cut '3-3' (=B3's own midspan) shows top=2-Ø16 / bottom=2-Ø16+1-Ø12; cut '3A-3A/3X-3X' (=B3A's and B3X's own section, shared) shows top=2-Ø16+1-Ø12 / bottom=2-Ø16 -- i.e. the extra bar sits on the support face for the short end-segments (B3A/B3X) and on the span face for B3's own midspan, standard continuous-beam curtailment. Recorded per-mark using each mark's own labelled cut, per schema §7's curtailment-merge convention (count includes the curtailed bar, mixed_dia_mm records both diameters, note explains the split).
B3, B3A and B3X share the identical 200x400mm size and Ø6@175mm stirrup -- confirmed by both boxed cross-sections.
